readme:
Short:        Locate a program file (OpenBSD)
Type:         util/cli
Architecture: m68k-amigaos >= 3.0
Uploader:     duncan (at) bowring (dot) us
Author:       Todd C. Miller (ported by Duncan Bowring)
Version:      1.27

which - Locate a program file in the user's path

Original author: Todd C. Miller
Source: OpenBSD which v1.27

Ported by Duncan Bowring using amiport (AI-assisted porting toolkit).
Project: https://github.com/bdgscotland/amiport

Cross-compiled with m68k-amigaos-gcc for AmigaOS 3.x (68000+).
Tested in FS-UAE with AmigaOS 3.1.

Usage:
  which [-a] name ...

Options:
  -a   List all matches in PATH, not just the first

PATH uses semicolon separator on AmigaOS: "C:;WORK:;SYS:Utilities"
Default PATH is C: if no PATH env var is set.

Includes full source code (original OpenBSD and ported Amiga versions)
and PORT.md documenting every transformation applied.
porting_notes: Standard Tier 1 port. Single source file (165 LOC). AmigaDOS PATH handling: semicolon-separated instead of colon, volume-colon path format (C:which vs /usr/bin/which). setgid/setuid/geteuid/getegid stubbed as no-ops (single-user AmigaOS). AmigaDOS case-insensitive filesystem handled. 23 tests cover PATH search, -a flag, direct path lookup, missing commands, mixed found/not-found (RC 5), default PATH fallback, case-insensitive matching, and stress invocations.
